description: Mutants of the authority Module (docs/architecture/target/v2/authority-rollback-declaration.zh-Hant.md section 9.4; tests/common/mutation/README.md). Run with tests/common/mutation/run_mutations.py --catalog.

mutants.what: the chosen strategy's startup check is not run (authority 4.4, 4.5). Only it catches the call
a World with no strategy is refused even without authority registrations (authority-rollback 4.2, authority 4.7: only a World with authority registrations needs one). Only it catches the condition
a World with authority registrations and no strategy is not reported (authority 4.7, AU-E2). Only it catches AU-E2
without a strategy the decision type is not put into the kernel (authority-rollback 4.2: the kernel R-E4 would hide AU-E2). Only it catches that path
the strategy is not called at a data registration (DI-A 11: on behalf at the call). Only it catches the call
mutants.cases: authority registrations: a decision type goes into*

mutants.what: the server authority does not register a decision type in the rollback Module (authority 4.3). Only it catches the on-behalf rollback registration
mutants.cases: authority registrations: a decision type goes into*

mutants.what: an input is registered as rollback state on behalf (authority 4.3, Z8: inputs are never); the World then fails with AU-E7. Only it catches the input filter of the on-behalf registration
NoRollback still registers the type as one that rolls back (authority 4.3). Only it catches the choice
Derived registers nothing (authority 4.3). Only it catches the Derived choice
the server authority adds the entry without the run condition (authority 4.4, D-E15). Only it catches the on-behalf condition
mutants.cases: authority registrations: an entry is added*

mutants.what: AU-E3 is not reported (authority 5.5: the decision part does not change after startup). Only it catches AU-E3
a Runs System that names nothing is not reported (DI-A 10, AU-E4). Only it catches the Runs half of AU-E4
a MarkResource that names nothing is not reported (DI-A 10, AU-E4). Only it catches the marks half of AU-E4
mutants.cases: authority registrations: a mark only records*

mutants.what: a System that writes Tick and is not on the time Module's list is not reported (authority 5.4, AU-E5). Only it catches AU-E5
mutants.find:
if (std::find(allowed.begin(), allowed.end(), system.name) != allowed.end()) continue;
            context.Report("AU-E5"

mutants.what: the time Module's driver is reported as a Tick writer (authority 5.4: the list is read). Only it catches the list
a System of a resimulated schedule writing decision data that does not roll back is not reported (Z6, AU-E6). Only it catches the System half of Z6
Z6 looks at every schedule, not only the resimulated ones (authority 5.11). Only it catches the schedule filter
a hook writing decision data that does not roll back is not reported (Z6 for hooks and observers). Only it catches the hook half
mutants.find: for (const Kernel::HookInfo& hook : registry.Hooks()) checkWriter("hook '" + hook.name + "'", hook.access);

mutants.what: the components a sync point fills through Registrar::InitialValue are not counted as written (authority-rollback 4.4, the funnel, B3). Only it catches the funnel
the tick is not the exception of Z6 (authority 5.11: it does not roll back; a resimulation moves it back). Only it catches the exception
a System skipped while resimulating (an entry writing the decision input) counts for Z6. Only it catches the exemption
a decision input registered as rollback state is not reported (Z8, AU-E7). Only it catches AU-E7
an entry in a resimulated schedule without the condition is not reported (D-E15, AU-E8). Only it catches AU-E8
a Runs System running a schedule not registered as nested is not reported (AU-E9). Only it catches AU-E9
the fingerprint numbers the decision types by kernel id instead of authority order (DI-A 5: a Client registers more ordinary data). Only it catches the numbering
mutants.cases: authority consistency: the fingerprint does not change*

mutants.what: the fingerprint takes every System, not only those writing decision data (DI-A 5). Only it catches the collection
mutants.cases: authority consistency: the fingerprint does not change*

mutants.what: a OneEndOnly System is taken into the fingerprint (DI-A 5). Only it catches OneEndOnly
mutants.cases: authority consistency: the fingerprint does not change*

mutants.what: the fingerprint keeps every System step of a Plan, not only the collected ones (DI-A 5: a Client has more Systems, such as the rollback record). Only it catches the reduction of the Plan
mutants.cases: authority consistency: the fingerprint does not change*

mutants.what: the fingerprint leaves out the Plan order (DI-A 5, P5: the tie order within a schedule). Only it catches the order
the strategy's name is not in the fingerprint (authority 5.5). Only it catches the strategy
the digest merges with XOR (DI-A 12: two equal cells cancel). Only it catches the merge
digestExclude is ignored (authority 5.6). Only it catches the exclusion
the types marked by type (the tick) are left out of the digest (authority 5.4: the tick is decision data). Only it catches the marks in the digest
mutants.find: if (mark.ops != nullptr && mark.ops->digest != nullptr) sum += mark.ops->digest(world, mark.seq);

mutants.what: G-5: a writer outside the owner root is left out silently instead of an error (the list never names a file the scanner cannot read). Only it catches the owner check
G-5 leaves out the files of Registrar::InitialValue functions for a decision component (authority 5.9). Only it catches them
mutants.find: add(rule.source, "the initial value of a decision component", registry.Components()[rule.target].name);
mutants.cases: authority consistency: G-5 lists the file of a Registrar::InitialValue*

mutants.what: the dataset report leaves out OneEndOnly (authority 4.3: the startup report lists every such mark). Only it catches that list
